lines.3: 「Yashi, this is an unusual place to run into you.」
lines.5: 「It's midnight. A first-year should be home asleep by now.」
lines.6: 「Being a first-year or a second-year has nothing to do with it, Sato-senpai.」
lines.8: 「I'm only taking a walk. I'll make a quick round and go home.」
lines.9: 「You've been hanging around the station this whole time, Yashi. People are starting to talk a little.」
lines.11: 「I see. Well, I won't pry. Good night, Yashi. See you at school.」
lines.14: 「...I have a bad feeling about her.」
